summary: E2E test of Covoiturage rating system (iter339). Full flow validated: driver publishes trip, client books 1 seat (12€), driver completes ride from Mes trajets, passenger rates driver 5★ + comment via modal (rate-modal/rate-star-5/rate-comment/rate-submit), driver rates passenger 4★, and after rating the buttons disappear correctly (already rated). The 2nd published trip from same driver now displays the average rating in search via StarBadge -> '★ 5 (1)' (data-testid=driver-rating). Unrated drivers display 'Nouveau ✦'. Backend pytest 5/5 PASS (test_iter338_carpool.py incl. test_rating_flow_and_average).
critical_code_review_comments: doComplete/doCancel use window.confirm() — fine but blocks automated tests unless dialog handler is registered (page.on('dialog', accept)). Consider migrating to in-app confirmation modal for better UX consistency.
StarBadge shows the average without indicating it's a count-1 rating (only '(1)' is shown). UX acceptable but could mention 'sur 1 trajet'.
carpool.py: anti-doublon, complétion required, $inc aggregation on user — implementation is solid; my-rides correctly returns can_rate.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 carpool rides (Trinité→Sainte-Marie 12€, Schoelcher→Fort-de-France 8€). After completion: driver wallet ~+10.20€ (12 - 15% commission); client wallet -12€. Driver received a 5★ rating from passenger and gave 4★ to passenger; aggregates: cp_driver_rating_count=1, cp_driver_rating_sum=5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route is /carpool. Login: /login → 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → 'Email & mot de passe' → fill email+password → click 'Se connecter'. doComplete/doCancelBooking/doCancelRide all use window.confirm() — register page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) in Playwright. data-testids verified: tab-search/tab-mine, publish-trip-btn, publish-from/to/when/seats/price/submit, book-trip-<id>, book-modal, book-confirm, mine-pax-<id>, mine-driver-<id>, complete-ride-<id>, rate-driver-<id>, rate-pax-<id>-<paxId>, rate-modal, rate-star-1..5, rate-comment, rate-submit, rate-close, driver-rating.
rca_of_the_issue: No bug found in this iteration. The rating system works end-to-end. First iteration of UI test missed the window.confirm() dialog on doComplete — adding page.on('dialog', accept) fixed it.
